about: Bars side by side that grow to their values as each is named: compare amounts, counts, sizes or shares across a few things.

labels.about: the things compared, split by | (or commas)

values.about: a number for each, in the same order

unit.about: written after each number, such as % or kg

highlight.about: labels drawn in the accent, split by |

when.about: moments each bar grows, such as @3,@7,@11; else each grows when its label is said, or they follow one another
